transcript: My friend, one day, whether by choice or by consequence, your body will become your greatest priority. In Chinese medicine we do not work out the Western way. We strengthen the Qi, we keep the joints open, we keep the blood warm and moving, so age cannot harden the body before its time. People think caring for the body is about looking strong, looking young, looking good in the mirror. But the elders taught something different. It is so that when you reach 80, your hands are still steady enough to care for yourself with dignity, so that your knees can still bend to climb even five steps without pain, so that your breath remains soft and deep and you can still walk freely under the morning sun. If you ignore your body's energy, life will force you to pay attention later, through stiffness, weakness, blocked Qi, poor digestion and the illnesses that come from stagnation. Do not wait for that day. Choose to warm the body. Choose gentle movement. Choose breath. Choose circulation. Choose a long, peaceful life. Your body is the garden where your spirit lives. Take care of it now, while the soil is still soft.
